task: I am going on a camping trip with my siblings. I had sent out a checklist of things needed for the trip to them over email. See who has committed to bring what, and place an order on Amazon for the remaining items. Given the available choices pick the highest rated ones.

emails.subject: Things Needed for Camping Trip
emails.body:
Hi Folks,
Here is the list of things we need,
- 1 quantity of snorkel mask
- 1 quantity of hammock
- 2 quantity of board game
- 1 quantity of camping chair
- 1 quantity of hiking boots
- 1 quantity of beach chair
- 2 quantity of sleeping pad
- 1 quantity of backpack
Please let me know what you can bring.
Best

emails.subject: Re: Things Needed for Camping Trip
emails.body: I can bring snorkel mask, hammock.

emails.subject: Re: Things Needed for Camping Trip
emails.body: I will bring board game, camping chair.

emails.subject: Re: Things Needed for Camping Trip
emails.body: I will bring hiking boots, beach chair.

emails.subject: Re: Re: Things Needed for Camping Trip
emails.body: Thanks all! I will buy the rest.

emails.subject: Camping Trip
emails.body:
Hi Folks,
Attaching a picture from our last camping trip. Looking forward to this one!
Best

emails.subject: Re: Camping Trip
emails.body: I am looking forward to it.

emails.subject: Camping Trip Help
emails.body:
Hey, I remember you have a great pair of binoculars. If you can bring them to
our camping trip, that would be great. Thanks!

emails.subject: Re: Camping Trip Help
emails.body:
Oh shoot! Sorry, I forgot to tell you. I am actually going on a trip with my
siblings. I will not be able to make it. Sorry!

emails.subject: Re: Re: Camping Trip Help
emails.body: Oh, that's too bad. Anyways, next time!
